history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration define criteria for what constitutes an entity and clarify which entities are included in the delegation of authority framework as contained in Secretary-General’s bulletin ST/SGB/2019/2.
history.administration_response: The Administration has defined more precise criteria for what constitutes an “entity” in accordance with the delegation of authority framework. The three criteria are as follows: (a) the office operates under the direct authority of the Secretary- General; (b) the office includes at least one United Nations Secretariat staff member who has a decision-making role in managing human, financial and physical resources and, therefore, can accept a delegation; (c) if the office lacks appropriate administrative capacity to execute decisions, it is supported by a Secretariat entity. The criteria are used when assessing whether heads of newly created “offices/units” need to receive delegated authority from the Secretary General. Consequently, the Administration considers this recommendation to be implemented and requests its closure.
history.board_assessment: Given that the latest version of ST/SGB/2019/2, which includes a definition of an “entity”, is in its finalization stage, the Board considers this recommendation to be implemented.
